res.mass.why.en: Everything you add must fit on the rocket. Structure adds about 22% on top of the parts, and propellant comes on top of that. OCO weighed 441 kg; its Taurus XL could lift 1,350 kg to low orbit.
res.mass.why.zh-TW: 加上去的東西都要塞得進火箭。結構大約再多 22%，推進劑另外算。OCO 重 441 公斤，金牛座 XL 能把 1,350 公斤送到低軌道。

res.power.why.en: In the Earth's shadow the battery runs everything, and in sunlight the panels must both run the satellite and recharge it, so the array has to be much bigger than the load. Panels also lose ~2.75% a year.
res.power.why.zh-TW: 在地球影子裡全靠電池供電；在陽光下太陽能板要同時供電又充電，所以面積要比負載大很多。太陽能板每年還會衰退約 2.75%。

res.budget.why.en: Development + launch + operations every year. Real missions keep a reserve because surprises always cost money.
res.budget.why.zh-TW: 開發費 + 發射費 + 每年營運費。真實任務都會保留準備金，因為意外一定會花錢。

res.data.why.en: Between ground-station passes, data waits in the onboard recorder. If it fills before the next pass, new data is lost.
res.data.why.zh-TW: 兩次過境之間，資料都存在衛星上的記錄器。下次過境前存滿了，新資料就會遺失。

res.comms.why.en: Each pass over a ground station lasts only 5-12 minutes. Rate × minutes per day must keep up with what the instruments collect. OCO needed just 6.75 minutes a day at 150 Mbit/s.
res.comms.why.zh-TW: 每次飛過地面站只有 5–12 分鐘。速率 × 每天通聯分鐘數要跟得上儀器產生的資料量。OCO 每天只需要以 150 Mbit/s 傳 6.75 分鐘。

res.time.why.en: The slowest part to build, or the wait for a launch slot, plus about 8 months of integration and testing.
res.time.why.zh-TW: 最慢做好的零件（或排到發射的等待時間），再加上約 8 個月的整合與測試。

warn.mass.en: {over:0} kg over what the {launcher} can lift to this orbit.
warn.mass.zh-TW: 超過{launcher}到這個軌道的運力 {over:0} 公斤。

warn.orbit_unreachable.en: This rocket cannot reach the chosen orbit.
warn.orbit_unreachable.zh-TW: 這支火箭到不了選擇的軌道。

warn.power.en: Power short by {short_w:0} W at end of mission: the panels cannot run the load and recharge the battery.
warn.power.zh-TW: 任務末期電力不足 {short_w:0} W：太陽能板撐不起負載又要充電。

warn.battery.en: Battery too small: {short_wh:0} Wh short for the {eclipse_min:0}-minute shadow at a safe depth of discharge.
warn.battery.zh-TW: 電池太小：要在安全放電深度下撐過 {eclipse_min:0} 分鐘的影子，還差 {short_wh:0} Wh。

warn.budget.zh-TW: 超出預算 {over:0.0} 百萬美元。

warn.storage.en: Recorder too small: {used:0.0} GB needed between passes (incl. 50% margin for missed passes), only {capacity:0} GB fitted. Data returned now: {return_pct:0}%.
warn.storage.zh-TW: 記錄器容量不足：兩次過境之間需要 {used:0.0} GB（含 50% 漏接餘裕），只裝了 {capacity:0} GB。目前能傳回 {return_pct:0}% 的資料。

warn.tight.en: {res} margin is only {margin_pct:0}%. Keep at least {need:0}% so an estimate error does not sink the mission.
warn.tight.zh-TW: {res}餘裕只剩 {margin_pct:0}%：建議至少留 {need:0}%，估計值有誤差時才不會出事。

warn.downlink.en: Downlink cannot keep up: {lost_pct:0}% of the data would be lost.
warn.downlink.zh-TW: 下傳跟不上：會遺失 {lost_pct:0}% 的資料。

warn.schedule.en: {over:0} months late for the launch window.
warn.schedule.zh-TW: 比發射窗口晚了 {over:0} 個月。

warn.lifetime.propellant.zh-TW: 推進劑 {years:0.0} 年就用完（目標 {target:0} 年）。

warn.lifetime.battery.en: The battery wears out after {years:0.0} years of shadow cycles (target {target:0}).
warn.lifetime.battery.zh-TW: 電池經過 {years:0.0} 年的影子充放電就耗損了（目標 {target:0} 年）。

warn.lifetime.radiation.en: Radiation kills the computer after {years:0.0} years (target {target:0}).
warn.lifetime.radiation.zh-TW: 輻射會在 {years:0.0} 年後毀掉電腦（目標 {target:0} 年）。

warn.instrument_mismatch.en: This instrument adds nothing to this mission's objective.
warn.instrument_mismatch.zh-TW: 這台儀器對本次任務目標沒有幫助。

warn.too_many_instruments.en: Too many instruments for this bus.
warn.too_many_instruments.zh-TW: 儀器數量超過這個平台能裝的上限。

nogo.time.en: We will miss the launch window.

nogo.data.en: No room on the recorder for a missed pass.
nogo.data.zh-TW: 記錄器容量不夠，漏接一次過境就會爆滿。

nogo.comms.en: We cannot downlink what we collect.
nogo.comms.zh-TW: 收集到的資料傳不回來。

nogo.science.en: No useful science for this objective.
nogo.science.zh-TW: 對這個任務目標沒有科學產出。

nogo.lifetime.en: It will not survive even one year.

launch.lower_orbit.en: Insertion into a lower orbit: the rocket had almost no margin left.
launch.lower_orbit.zh-TW: 進入較低的軌道：火箭幾乎沒有剩餘運力。

launch.anomaly.en: Launch vehicle anomaly. The spacecraft was lost.
launch.anomaly.zh-TW: 火箭發生異常，太空船損失。

launch.overweight.en: Too heavy: the rocket could not reach orbital velocity.
launch.overweight.zh-TW: 太重了：火箭達不到入軌速度。

launch.unreachable.en: This rocket cannot reach that orbit.
launch.unreachable.zh-TW: 這支火箭到不了那個軌道。

launch.fairing.en: The payload fairing did not separate. Carrying its extra mass, the rocket fell short of orbit.
launch.fairing.zh-TW: 酬載整流罩沒有分離。多背著這些重量，火箭到不了軌道。

event.prompt.solarstorm.en: {event} is heading our way. Safe mode protects the spacecraft but stops observations for {days} days. Keep running and risk damage?
event.prompt.solarstorm.zh-TW: {event}正朝這裡來。安全模式可以保護太空船，但會停止觀測 {days} 天。要繼續運作冒損壞風險嗎？

event.prompt.scienceopportunity.en: A major {opportunity} is under way. Spend extra power to image it intensively?
event.prompt.scienceopportunity.zh-TW: 正在發生一場重大{opportunity}。要多耗電加密觀測嗎？

event.storm.safe.en: Safe mode: {days} days without observations, spacecraft unharmed.
event.storm.safe.zh-TW: 安全模式：{days} 天沒有觀測，太空船毫髮無傷。

event.storm.ok.en: We kept observing and got lucky: no damage.
event.storm.ok.zh-TW: 繼續觀測，運氣不錯：沒有損壞。

event.storm.damaged.en: Radiation damaged {part}: it now works at half capacity.
event.storm.damaged.zh-TW: 輻射損壞了{part}：現在只剩一半能力。

event.failure.redundant.en: The backup took over automatically. No impact.
event.failure.redundant.zh-TW: 備援自動接手，沒有影響。

event.failure.computer.en: Half of the recorder is gone: storage cut to 50%.
event.failure.computer.zh-TW: 記錄器壞了一半：儲存容量剩 50%。

event.failure.adcs.en: Pointing is degraded: every instrument loses 25%.
event.failure.adcs.zh-TW: 指向精度變差：每台儀器少 25% 產出。

event.failure.antenna.en: The transmitter is degraded: downlink halved.
event.failure.antenna.zh-TW: 發射機降級：下傳速度減半。

event.opportunity.strained.en: Captured it, but the power system was strained: half the bonus and extra battery wear.
event.opportunity.strained.zh-TW: 拍到了，但電力吃緊：只有一半加分，電池也多耗損了。

cause.mass_total.en: Launch mass {wet} kg vs. {launcher}'s {cap} kg to this orbit.
cause.mass_total.zh-TW: 發射質量 {wet} 公斤，{launcher}到這個軌道只能載 {cap} 公斤。

cause.launch_overweight.en: Overweight: the rocket could not reach orbital speed.
cause.launch_overweight.zh-TW: 超重：火箭達不到入軌速度。

cause.launch_anomaly.en: This flight was one of the failures.
cause.launch_anomaly.zh-TW: 這次剛好是失敗的那一次。

cause.fairing_mass.en: The extra mass left it ~300 m/s short of orbital velocity.
cause.fairing_mass.zh-TW: 多出的重量讓它差了約每秒 300 公尺的入軌速度。

cause.lower_orbit.en: The rocket ran out of performance and left us in a lower orbit.
cause.lower_orbit.zh-TW: 火箭推力用盡，把衛星留在較低的軌道。

cause.drag_doubled.en: Thicker air doubled the drag; the mission lasted {years} years.
cause.drag_doubled.zh-TW: 大氣較濃，阻力加倍；任務撐了 {years} 年。

cause.data_generated.en: {part} and the other instruments produce {gb} GB a day.

cause.storage_capacity.zh-TW: {part}在兩次過境之間只能存 {gb} GB。

cause.downlink_capacity.en: {part} with {stations} station(s) can send {gb} GB a day.
cause.downlink_capacity.zh-TW: {part}配 {stations} 座地面站，每天只能傳 {gb} GB。

cause.data_lost.en: {pct}% of the data never came home.

cause.power_load.en: The load needs {w} W from the array.
cause.power_load.zh-TW: 負載需要太陽能板提供 {w} W。

cause.array_eol.en: After {years} years the panels deliver only {w} W.
cause.array_eol.zh-TW: {years} 年後太陽能板只剩 {w} W。

cause.duty.en: Instruments ran only {pct}% of the time.
cause.duty.zh-TW: 儀器只有 {pct}% 的時間在運作。

cause.ended_early.en: The mission ended after {years} of {target} years.
cause.ended_early.zh-TW: 任務在第 {years} 年結束（目標 {target} 年）。

cause.orbit_drag.en: {orbit} needs {dv} m/s a year to fight drag.
cause.orbit_drag.zh-TW: {orbit}每年需要 {dv} m/s 對抗阻力。

cause.eclipses.en: {n} shadow passes a year, each draining the battery to {dod}%.
cause.eclipses.zh-TW: 每年進出影子 {n} 次，每次電池放電到 {dod}%。

cause.degraded.en: The rest of the mission ran degraded.
cause.degraded.zh-TW: 剩下的任務都降級運作。

cause.success_return.en: {pct}% of the data made it home.

suggest.launcher_reach.en: Pick a rocket that can reach your orbit (check the capacity table).
suggest.launcher_reach.zh-TW: 選一支到得了你的軌道的火箭（看運力表）。

suggest.mass.en: Lighten the spacecraft or move up to a bigger rocket.
suggest.mass.zh-TW: 減輕太空船，或換更大的火箭。

suggest.launcher.en: A more reliable rocket costs more, but it is insurance for everything on top of it.
suggest.launcher.zh-TW: 可靠的火箭比較貴，但它是上面所有東西的保險。

suggest.history_launcher.en: Try a different rocket. That is what NASA did.
suggest.history_launcher.zh-TW: 換一支火箭試試。NASA 當年就是這麼做的。

suggest.mass_margin.en: Leave at least 5% of the rocket's capacity unused.
suggest.mass_margin.zh-TW: 火箭運力至少留 5% 不要用滿。

suggest.downlink.en: Add ground stations or a faster antenna, or carry fewer data-hungry instruments.
suggest.downlink.zh-TW: 增加地面站或換更快的天線，或少帶資料量大的儀器。

suggest.storage.en: A bigger recorder, or more ground stations so it empties more often.
suggest.storage.zh-TW: 換更大的記錄器，或增加地面站讓它更常清空。

suggest.power.en: Bigger panels, or drop the most power-hungry instrument.
suggest.power.zh-TW: 加大太陽能板，或拿掉最耗電的儀器。

suggest.propellant.en: Carry more propellant, or fly higher where drag is weaker.
suggest.propellant.zh-TW: 多帶推進劑，或飛高一點讓阻力變小。

suggest.battery.en: A bigger battery discharges less deeply each orbit and lasts many more cycles.
suggest.battery.zh-TW: 電池加大，每圈放電較淺，循環壽命會長很多。

suggest.shielding.en: Thicker shielding or a radiation-hardened computer.
suggest.shielding.zh-TW: 加厚屏蔽，或換抗輻射電腦。

suggest.safe_mode.en: When a big storm hits, safe mode is usually cheaper than damage.
suggest.safe_mode.zh-TW: 大風暴來時，進安全模式通常比受損划算。

suggest.redundancy.en: Redundant parts (spare wheels, dual computers) turn a failure into a non-event.
suggest.redundancy.zh-TW: 備援零件（備用反應輪、雙電腦）能讓故障變成小事。

suggest.more_science.en: You had money to spare: try a more capable instrument.
suggest.more_science.zh-TW: 預算還有剩：試試更強的儀器。

ui.difficulty.engineer.en: Full information and suggested fixes. Department requirements ask for a 15% design margin.
ui.difficulty.engineer.zh-TW: 所有資訊都看得到，警告會附上建議解法。部門要求 15% 的設計餘裕。

ui.difficulty.cadet.en: Bigger budget, fewer parts, gentler operations. Warnings come with fixes.
ui.difficulty.cadet.zh-TW: 預算多一半、零件選擇少、營運事件較少，警告附解法。適合第一次玩。

ui.difficulty.director.en: Tight budget, more events, and only red lights: you diagnose the problems yourself.
ui.difficulty.director.zh-TW: 預算更緊、事件更多，警告只亮紅燈：問題要自己找出來。

ui.title.eyebrow.en: NASA SPACE APPS · SATELLITE MISSION DESIGN
ui.title.eyebrow.zh-TW: NASA SPACE APPS · 衛星任務設計

ui.title.tagline.en: Design a satellite on real NASA numbers, poll your team, launch it, and live with the consequences.
ui.title.tagline.zh-TW: 用 NASA 的真實數據設計一顆衛星，召開 Go/No-Go 點名，發射，然後面對你的每一個決定。

ui.title.training_desc.en: Step-by-step tips in the design room.
ui.title.training_desc.zh-TW: 在設計室一步一步提示操作。

ui.title.credits.en: Data: NASA DONKI, NASA 3D Resources, NASA Earth Observatory, NASA audio, published mission specs (sources in each data file). Fan-made educational game: no NASA endorsement implied.
ui.title.credits.zh-TW: 資料：NASA DONKI、NASA 3D Resources、NASA Earth Observatory、NASA 錄音與公開任務規格（每筆資料都附來源）。教育用途的非官方作品，不代表 NASA 背書。

ui.brief.requirements_desc.en: Each department has its own goal. Meeting them raises your teamwork score.
ui.brief.requirements_desc.zh-TW: 每個部門都有自己的目標，全部達成可以提高團隊分數。

ui.history.locked.en: First you fly it exactly as it was flown. The design is locked until you find out what happened.
ui.history.locked.zh-TW: 先照當年的設計原樣發射一次。知道發生什麼事之前，設計是鎖住的。

ui.history.you_rewrote.en: You rewrote history: your spacecraft reached orbit.
ui.history.you_rewrote.zh-TW: 你改寫了歷史：你的衛星成功進入軌道。

ui.history.still_failed.en: History repeated itself. Look at the launcher.
ui.history.still_failed.zh-TW: 歷史重演了。看看火箭的選擇。

ui.design.instrument_full.en: Instrument slots are full. Remove one first.
ui.design.instrument_full.zh-TW: 儀器位置滿了，先移除一台。

ui.design.all_clear.en: All flight rules satisfied. Ready for the Go/No-Go poll.
ui.design.all_clear.zh-TW: 所有飛行規則都通過了，可以召開 Go/No-Go 點名。

ui.design.lights_only.en: {n} red light(s). Director difficulty: find the cause yourself.
ui.design.lights_only.zh-TW: {n} 個紅燈。總監難度：原因要自己找。

ui.design.call_poll.zh-TW: 召開 GO / NO-GO 點名

ui.design.years_hint.en: Longer missions return more science but cost more to operate and wear the spacecraft.
ui.design.years_hint.zh-TW: 任務越長科學成果越多，但營運成本更高，太空船也更耗損。

ui.design.sunlit_only.en: Only works in sunlight: it is idle during eclipses.
ui.design.sunlit_only.zh-TW: 只能在日照下工作：進入地球影子時停機。

ui.design.locked_desc.en: This is the design as it was flown. Call the poll to relive the launch.
ui.design.locked_desc.zh-TW: 這是當年實際飛行的設計。召開點名，重新經歷那次發射。

ui.design.locked_toast.en: The design is locked during the history replay.
ui.design.locked_toast.zh-TW: 重演歷史時設計是鎖住的。

ui.design.rewrite_desc.en: Now you know what went wrong. Change anything you like and fly again.
ui.design.rewrite_desc.zh-TW: 現在你知道問題出在哪了。任意修改設計，再飛一次。

ui.training.brief.en: Read the department requirements on the right: they are the private goals of your four teammates. Then enter the design room.
ui.training.brief.zh-TW: 右邊是四個部門的要求，也就是四位隊友各自的目標。看完就進入設計室。

ui.training.step1.en: These six bars are your budget of physics: mass, power, money, storage, downlink and schedule. Green is fine, amber is tight, red will get a NO-GO.
ui.training.step1.zh-TW: 右邊六條是你的物理預算：質量、電力、金錢、儲存、下傳與時程。綠色沒問題、橘色很緊、紅色在點名時會被喊 NO-GO。

ui.training.step2.en: Hover over any part on the left: a white marker shows where each bar would move before you commit. Click to install it.
ui.training.step2.zh-TW: 把滑鼠移到左邊的零件上：白色標記會先告訴你每條資源條會變到哪裡。點一下才會裝上去。

ui.training.step3.en: The tabs switch between the four departments. Each controls different systems: the scientist picks instruments, comms picks the orbit and antenna.
ui.training.step3.zh-TW: 上面的分頁切換四個部門。每個部門管不同系統：科學家選儀器，通訊負責軌道與天線。

ui.training.step4.en: Flight rules explain every red light. The buttons under each one are fixes the computer has verified: hover to preview, click to apply.
ui.training.step4.zh-TW: 飛行規則會解釋每一個紅燈。下面的按鈕是電腦驗證過的解法：滑鼠移上去預覽，點一下套用。

ui.training.step5.en: When the bars look healthy, call the Go/No-Go poll. Every department must answer GO before you can launch.
ui.training.step5.zh-TW: 資源條都健康之後，召開 Go/No-Go 點名。每個部門都回答 GO 才能發射。

ui.rollcall.eyebrow.zh-TW: 任務控制中心 · 飛行總監頻道

ui.rollcall.desc.en: Each console checks its own systems against the flight rules and calls GO or NO-GO.
ui.rollcall.desc.zh-TW: 每個席位依飛行規則檢查自己負責的系統，回答 GO 或 NO-GO。

ui.rollcall.station.engineer.zh-TW: 質量 · 電力 · 壽命

ui.rollcall.req_unmet.en: GO, but our department goal is not met.
ui.rollcall.req_unmet.zh-TW: GO，但本部門的要求沒有達成。

ui.rollcall.first_call_bonus.en: All GO on the first poll: teamwork bonus.
ui.rollcall.first_call_bonus.zh-TW: 第一次點名就全員 GO：團隊加分。

ui.rollcall.unmet_warning.en: Some department goals are not met. You can still launch, but the teamwork score will suffer.
ui.rollcall.unmet_warning.zh-TW: 有部門的要求沒達成。還是可以發射，但團隊分數會被扣。

ui.rollcall.hold_desc.en: At least one station called NO-GO. Fix the red lights and poll again.
ui.rollcall.hold_desc.zh-TW: 至少一個席位喊了 NO-GO。修好紅燈再點名一次。

ui.launch.call.go.en: Range is green. We are GO for launch.

ui.launch.call.pitch.en: Vehicle has started its pitch and roll program.
ui.launch.call.pitch.zh-TW: 火箭開始俯仰與滾轉程序。

ui.launch.call.fairing_fail.zh-TW: 沒有整流罩分離的訊號……

ui.launch.call.underspeed.en: Vehicle is under speed. It will not make orbit.
ui.launch.call.underspeed.zh-TW: 速度不足，無法進入軌道。

ui.launch.call.anomaly.en: We have lost telemetry. Flight controllers are assessing.
ui.launch.call.anomaly.zh-TW: 遙測中斷，飛控人員正在評估。

ui.launch.call.orbit.en: Engine cutoff. We are in orbit.

ui.launch.call.lower.en: Insertion is lower than planned, but we are in orbit.
ui.launch.call.lower.zh-TW: 入軌高度比預期低，但已進入軌道。

ui.launch.call.deploy.zh-TW: 衛星分離，太陽能板展開中。

ui.ops.year_of.zh-TW: 第 {y} 年 / 共 {t} 年

ui.ops.chart.battery.en: Battery charge at end of eclipse

ui.ops.donki_source.en: Event from NASA DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information).
ui.ops.donki_source.zh-TW: 事件取自 NASA DONKI 太空天氣資料庫。

ui.ops.end.summary.en: {years} years in orbit · {data} TB downlinked · {pct} of the data made it home.
ui.ops.end.summary.zh-TW: 在軌 {years} 年 · 下傳 {data} TB · {pct} 的資料成功傳回。

ui.report.grade.s.en: Outstanding: a mission NASA would be proud of.
ui.report.grade.s.zh-TW: 傑出：NASA 會引以為傲的任務。

ui.report.grade.b.en: A solid mission with room to improve.
ui.report.grade.b.zh-TW: 穩健的任務，還有進步空間。

ui.report.grade.c.en: The mission flew, but returned little.
